name: oms-ingest-amps-c
description: AMPS SOW feeds for system C instead of Kafka (docs/design/11 section 5): the in-worker client and the Derived Table Writer into OMS_RAW.OrdersC. Enable this and disable oms-ingest-c when system C publishes to AMPS. OMS_AMPS_PERSIST_SNAPSHOT=true on the first start of a trading day only.
